title: A Home for Humble Hearts
traveler_why: Beau is the brave one, and tonight bravery is quiet: a plant knocked over, dirt swept under the couch, and the courage to tug a dad's sleeve and tell the whole thing, because Isaiah says the Lord lives with the humble, honest heart.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because telling the truth about yourself is its own kind of bravery. In Beau’s world today: Beau knocked a plant off the windowsill and swept the dirt under the couch. His stomach ached all through lunch. Finally he tugged his dad’s sleeve and told him the whole thing. Just like the humble heart Heavenly Father chose to dwell with, Beau learned that honesty makes room for peace.
